statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
These symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code is I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73 and G45.9
The cardiac event monitoring study was indicated to identify arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events
The cardiac event monitoring study was indicated to guide anticoagulation management
The denial reason code is CO-97
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
